name: A rolled-back candidate consumes no owner revision number

input.source_text: class A { }; let before = A.active_revision; try { A.open() { |t| t.define_method(:x) { 1 }; raise :stop } } catch e { nil }; let after_failed = A.active_revision; A.open() { |t| t.define_method(:y) { 2 } }; [after_failed - before, A.active_revision - before]

applicability.reason: The owner revision sequence is source-observable; runtime-wide commit allocation needs a Host audit probe.
